Consequence: the self-test's healthy control passed vacuously, and the production --require path could report 'PASS — no diagnostics' when the checker never started; the negative control failed, but for the wrong reason. It now resolves the checker from the repo root for the self-test, derives ran from the spawn error/status, and requires the expected exit codes: the wrong-type control is genuinely caught (TS2322), the healthy control is genuinely clean, and a missing checker fails loudly. A focused, different-agent verification returned PASS (probes A/A2/B/D; the production before/after is the false PASS).

The coexistence boot uses a minimal bundle set (dsh-base + mpd + silicon), so mpd's preset-mpd cannot activate without an agentPresets provider; no claim is made about a full dsh-tui composition.

`dsh plugin --profile … add <repo>` could not complete inside this sandbox: pnpm/corepack failed with ERR_PNPM_STORE_DIR_OPEN_OPERATION_LOCK (EROFS on its store operation lock). The boots and tool calls therefore used a manually assembled profile (package.json bundles + node_modules symlinks) with an isolated DSH_HOME and HOME; the row set is the same one `dsh plugin add` produces. This is a QA-environment bound, not a bundle defect.
The MCP status call needs a clean daemon state under HOME; a reused HOME after the daemon owner changes returns the structured deferral error documented above. Clearing ~/.mpd/lsp-daemon resolves it.

The real model call read the operator's credential at runtime from the credential store into the process environment. No sandbox path links to the credential store, and the key was never written into the repository or into any evidence file. The sandbox profiles symlink three read-only installed package trees (@mpd-dsh/mpd, @deepseek-ai, @dsh-std) under ~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-tui/node_modules so the coexistence boot can mount them without reinstalling.
The answer above is bound to the recorded headless run; the model call itself was not re-executed by the independent reviewer (contract exclusion), only its artifacts were inspected.
